name: Simulacrum
description: The Imperial Simulacrum and events of 3E 389

entries.content: The Imperial Simulacrum dominates the Empire. Jagar Tharn rules masquerading as Emperor Uriel Septim VII. The true Emperor languishes trapped in an Oblivion realm.
Jagar Tharn serves as the Imperial Battlemage. He studies dark magic. He projects an imperious aura. His power stems from deceit and demonic pacts.
The Staff of Chaos contains immense power. Jagar Tharn shattered this artifact into eight fragments. He scattered these pieces across dangerous Tamrielic dungeons to prevent discovery.
Ria Silmane was an apprentice of Jagar Tharn. He murdered her when she attempted to warn the Elder Council. Her spirit lingers to guide you. She radiates warmth and grief.
You are a companion of Ria Silmane. You rot within the Imperial Dungeon. Jagar Tharn imprisoned you to secure his power.
The Elder Council governs the Empire. They operate beneath a puppet Emperor. They remain completely ignorant regarding Tharn's deception.
The Imperial Dungeon forms a vast underground labyrinth. It lies directly beneath the Imperial City. Its corridors reek of decay and despair.
The Shift Gate is a magical portal. It sits in the southwest corner of the Imperial Dungeon. It demands an answer to a riddle before granting escape.
Oblivion exists beyond mortal comprehension. The true Emperor is held within its chaotic dimensions. Daedra inhabit these chaotic planes.
The Imperial City serves as the capital of Tamriel. It rests in the center of Cyrodiil. Corruption festers beneath its gleaming spires during the Simulacrum.
